product_one_liner.value: CoLab provides AI-powered CAD and drawing design-review software that helps mechanical engineering and hardware product-development teams capture feedback, reuse engineering knowledge, and make faster design decisions.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes AI-powered design reviews and faster engineering decisions; product overview describes design review workflows.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer offers demo/contact options but no pricing link or public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: All four names appear on the company's customer page.

employee_band.notes: The company page reports 150+ employees, which falls within the 101-200 band.

hq_location.notes: CoLab's own about page says it was born in St. John's, Newfoundland; Built In identifies the headquarters as Newfoundland and Labrador.

founded_year.notes: The company about page gives 2017 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog includes multiple product-building/technical posts, including an engineer-authored account of building AI-powered DFM checks and a technical integration explanation.

public_docs.notes: The homepage links to support, but the available evidence did not establish a public documentation or help center with several articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open-roles listing includes a Senior 3D & AI role.

model_provider.notes: The company's security information names Anthropic and OpenAI among AI service providers.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page states CoLab completes SOC 2 Type 2 audits and holds ISO 27001 certification; only requested certification categories are listed.

last_funding.notes: CoLab announced a $72 million USD Series C on November 10, 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: The November 10, 2025 Series C announcement falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The accessible careers-page results did not establish whether a currently open role has one of the specified SDR, BDR, or account-executive titles.

launched_6mo.notes: CoLab announced its 4.0 platform release on July 9, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The May 6, 2026 announcement says Tom Greever and Jessie Wheeler joined as SVPs.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The integrations page names engineering/product tools such as Windchill, SolidWorks, Teamcenter, 3DEXPERIENCE, and Jira, but no CRM or sales/marketing system; available job listings likewise did not provide a named CRM stack signal.
